combo_label: The Human Body × Photography × The Titanic

entries.clue: Perforated strip wound in a canister, ruined by a carelessly opened door
Soft darkening that gathers at the corners, drawing the eye inward
Spark-gap apparatus in a room abaft the bridge, worked by Phillips and Bride
Notice of ice sent by another ship, several of which reached her bridge
Blind that flicks open for a split instant, then seals out the light
Curved bone in the cage that guards the lungs.
Setting marked B that lets light in while your finger stays pressed, for star trails
Shipyard city where Harland and Wolff built her and slid her into the water
Bone of the lower arm on the side of the smallest digit.
Tiny blood fragment that clumps to seal a scratch.
Oak-panelled sweep under an iron and glass dome, the first-class showpiece
Passage at the front of the neck that food and air both share
